# **I. Overview**

## **1\. Context Diagram**

The context diagram shows TuConnector as a single process and its interactions with five human actors and five external systems. Each external entity has two data flows: one into the system and one out of the system (the arrow head shows the direction). Compared with the initial draft, the Admin actor, the Guest actor, Email Service and Google OAuth were added to cover account verification, moderation and sign-in flow

![][image2]

*Figure 1\. Context diagram TuConnector*

## **2\. User Requirements**

### **2.1 Introduction**

TuConnector is a web platform that acts as a trusted third party connecting tutors with parents who need tutoring for their children, and at the same time provides tutors with a teaching workspace and students with a learning dashboard.

**Business problem.** In Vietnam, parents usually find tutors through acquaintances, social-media groups or traditional tutoring centres. Information about tutors' qualifications is hard to verify, matching is manual and slow, payments are informal, and after hiring there is no shared place to manage schedules, materials, homework and progress. Tutors, on the other hand, juggle Zalo/Facebook groups, spreadsheets and calendars to run their classes.

**Product vision.** TuConnector provides (1) a marketplace with tutor profiles, tutoring requests, AI-assisted matching, hiring and secure online payment; (2) a tutor workspace for classrooms, group chats, schedules synchronised with Google Calendar, materials, assignments and an AI Teaching Assistant; and (3) dashboards for students and parents to follow learning progress.

**Scope of release 1.0:**

* Account management with email/Google sign-in for Parent, Tutor, Student and Admin.

* Tutor discovery: search, profiles, posts and AI tutor suggestions.

* Hiring: tutoring requests, applications, tutor invitations, connection credits and online payment for plans and credit packs.

* Tutor workspace: classrooms, members, materials, assignments & grading, recurring schedule, Google Calendar sync, group chat and AI Teaching Assistant.

* Student dashboard and parent progress monitoring, feedback & rating.

* Administration: user management, moderation, master data and statistics.

*Out of scope: native mobile apps, built-in video conferencing (sessions use external meeting links such as Google Meet/Zoom), automatic payout to tutors' bank accounts (handled manually by Admin in release 1.0).*

**Constraints & assumptions:**

* Web application, responsive, Vietnamese/English UI

* Proposed stack: ReactJS front-end, Express.js back-end, MongoDB for database

* External services: Google Gemini API (AI Provider), Payment Gateway Service, Google Calendar API & Google OAuth, SMTP/SendGrid (Email).

* Project effort is limited to 400 man-hours for a team of 5 members (≈ 80 hours per member, 10 weeks).

* Users have internet access and a valid email; tutors can provide identity/qualification documents.

### **2.2 Actors**

| \# | Actor | Description |
| :---: | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | Guest | An unauthenticated visitor who can browse the landing page, search tutors, view public profiles and posts, and register an account. |
| 2 | Parent | A parent/guardian who needs tutoring for their child(ren). Posts tutoring requests, receives AI tutor suggestions, invites tutors (one credit per invitation) or answers tutor applications, chats with tutors, can join classes, monitors children's progress and rates tutors. Parents use connection credits (Free / Pro plan) to send invitations. |
| 3 | Tutor | A tutor/teacher with a public profile. Manages posts, applies to requests using connection credits (Free / Pro plan), answers invitations, and uses the optional workspace: classrooms, members, materials, AI-generated assignments, schedule and group chats. |
| 4 | Student | A learner who joins a tutor's classroom by invite link or join code. Uses the Student Dashboard to follow the schedule, do assignments, view results, request schedule changes and chat with the class. |
| 5 | Admin | The platform operator. Manages user accounts, moderates content and reports, configures plans and pricing (credits, AI quota, SMS reminders) and monitors system statistics. |

*Table 2\. Actors (5 human actors)*

**External systems (secondary / system actors):**

| External system | Role |
| ----- | ----- |
| AI Provider (e.g. Google Gemini API) | Generates AI output for three features: tutor suggestions for parents, request (post) suggestions for tutors and assignment generation. |
| Payment Gateway (e.g. PayOS / VNPay) | Processes online payments for Pro plan subscriptions and credit packs (QR/bank/card) and returns the result via redirect and IPN webhook. |
| Google Calendar API | Creates/updates/deletes calendar events for class sessions in users' Google Calendars. |
| Email / SMS Service (SMTP / SendGrid, SMS gateway) | Sends verification, reset password and notification emails, and SMS session reminders for the Pro plan. |
| Google OAuth | Authenticates users with a Google account (sign-in and calendar consent). |

*Table 3\. External systems*

| UC35 | Dashboard & Feedback | Parent | Monitor Child Progress | Allows a parent to follow each linked child's attendance, assignment scores, tutor feedback and schedule. |

## **3\. Main Workflows**

### **3.1 WF-01: Tutor – Parent Connection**

The core connection flow. A parent posts a tutoring request; if the content filter (BR-17) flags it, the request goes back to Draft and the parent is notified with the reason; otherwise the system publishes it and shows AI tutor suggestions to the parent and AI post suggestions to tutors. A connection can start in two ways: a tutor applies to the request (one credit is deducted from the tutor), or the parent invites a tutor (one credit is deducted from the parent). Either side can buy credits or upgrade the plan when credits run out (UC17). The parent chooses Continue or Skip for an application, and the tutor chooses Continue or Decline for an invitation; credits already spent are not refunded. On Continue, a 1-1 conversation opens at no extra cost, where both sides can share Zalo or phone. Creating a tutoring agreement is optional; when one side proposes it and the other confirms, the request is closed, rating is enabled and the tutor is suggested to create a classroom.

**Related use cases:** UC07, UC09, UC10–UC17, UC32

![][image10]

Figure 9\. WF-01: Tutor – Parent Connection

### **3.2 WF-02: Classroom Setup & Scheduling**

The optional workspace flow. Only the tutor creates a classroom (a basic class is free); the system generates an invite link, a join code and a class group chat. Students and parents join through the link or code. The tutor schedules sessions with conflict checking and Google Calendar synchronisation; reminders are sent by email (Free) and SMS (Pro). Students or parents can request a schedule change, which the tutor approves or rejects.

**Related use cases:** UC19, UC21, UC22, UC26–UC31, UC33

![][image11]

Figure 10\. WF-02: Classroom Setup & Scheduling

### **3.3 WF-03: Assignment, Grading & Progress Monitoring**

The assignment loop. The tutor generates an assignment with AI (within the plan's AI quota) or creates it manually, edits the questions (multiple choice, short answer, file upload) and publishes it. Students do the assignment on the web; multiple-choice items are graded automatically and the tutor grades the rest. Results go to the student and parent dashboards, and the parent can rate the tutor once, at any time after the connection is confirmed.

**Related use cases:** UC24, UC25, UC34–UC36

![][image12]

Figure 11\. WF-03: Assignment, Grading

Data-level rules: Parents query/update only their own requests, agreements, credits and linked children; Tutors only their own profile, posts, applications, classrooms and credits; Students only classes they joined and their own submissions; Admin can query all data but can only change account status, moderation and settings (all actions audited – BR-16).

*Table 6\. Screen authorization (X \= allowed)*

### **4.4 Non-UI Functions**

| \# | Feature | System Function | Description |
| :---: | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | Notification | Notification Service | Pushes real-time in-app notifications via WebSocket (Socket.IO) and sends emails through the Email Service according to user preferences. |
| 2 | Matching | Matching Engine | Scores tutor–request pairs (subject, grade, mode, area, schedule overlap, budget fit, rating, response rate). Produces Tutor Suggestions for parents and Student Suggestions for tutors; calls the AI Provider for natural-language explanations. |
| 3 | Payment | Payment Webhook (IPN) Handler | Receives Payment Gateway callbacks, verifies checksum and amount, updates the order idempotently, then upgrades the plan or adds the purchased credits. |
| 4 | Schedule | Google Calendar Sync Worker | Queues calendar create/update/delete jobs, refreshes OAuth tokens, retries failed syncs with back-off. |
| 5 | Scheduler | Expiry Jobs (cron) | Every 5 min: expire pending payment orders (15 min). Daily: expire tutoring requests (30 days). Monthly: grant plan credits and expire unused monthly credits. |
| 6 | Scheduler | Session Reminder Job | Sends reminders 24 h and 30 min before each session; generates weekly progress digests for parents. |
| 7 | Moderation | Content Filter | Checks text for prohibited words, phone numbers, emails and links; masks contact information (BR-15); flagged posts/requests stay in Draft and flagged feedback is not saved, with the reason shown to the author (BR-17). |
| 8 | AI | AI Gateway | Central wrapper for the AI Provider: prompt templates, context building, quota enforcement, safety filter, streaming, logging and cost tracking. |
| 9 | Security | Audit Logging | Records Admin actions and security events (login failures, invalid payment callbacks). |

*Table 7\. Non-UI functions*

## **5\. Business Rules**

| ID | Rule | Description |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| BR-01 | Account & password | Email must be unique. Password: 8–64 characters with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter and one digit. |
| BR-02 | Login lockout | After 5 consecutive failed logins the account is locked for login until the user resets the password through the email link (UC03). |
| BR-03 | One-time tokens | Verification and reset-password links/OTP are single-use and valid for 15 minutes (verification: 24 hours). |
| BR-04 | Tutoring request | A request must include subject, grade, mode (online/offline), area (if offline), preferred schedule and budget/session. An Open request expires automatically after 30 days. Max 5 open requests per parent. |
| BR-05 | Applications | A tutor can apply only once per request and have at most 10 Pending applications at a time. |
| BR-06 | Payment orders | All amounts are in VND. Each order has a unique order code (idempotent processing). A pending order expires after 15 minutes. |
| BR-07 | Feedback eligibility | Only a parent with a confirmed tutoring agreement can rate the tutor; one feedback per agreement, rating 1–5, editable within 7 days. |
| BR-08 | Classroom | Join code: 6–8 alphanumeric characters, unique, regenerable. Default capacity 50 students (configurable by Admin). |
| BR-09 | Parent–child link | A parent sends a link request to a student account; the link becomes active only after the student accepts it (Pending → Accepted / Declined). A parent sees only the data of accepted linked children. |
| BR-10 | Sessions | A tutor cannot have overlapping sessions. Changes are synchronised to Google Calendar within 1 minute when connected; reminders are sent 24 hours and 30 minutes before a session. |
| BR-11 | Assignments | Submissions after the deadline are marked Late and accepted only if the tutor enabled late submission. |
| BR-12 | Files | Max 20 MB per file (avatar 5 MB). Allowed: pdf, doc/docx, ppt/pptx, xls/xlsx, jpg, png, mp4, zip. |
| BR-13 | AI usage | Each user has an AI quota per monthly plan cycle (set per plan in UC39). AI output is a draft; tutors must review before publishing to students. Failed AI calls do not consume quota. |
| BR-14 | Chat permission | Only members can read/send in a group. A 1-1 chat between a parent and a tutor is allowed only after an application is continued by the parent or an invitation is continued by the tutor. |
| BR-15 | Contact protection | Tutor/parent phone numbers and emails are hidden and auto-masked in public profiles, posts and requests; inside an opened 1-1 conversation both sides may share them (contact card). |
| BR-16 | Admin audit | Every Admin action requires a reason and is written to the audit log: suspend/ban a user \= LOCK\_USER, reactivate \= UNLOCK\_USER, warn \= WARN\_USER, approve/hide/remove content \= MODERATE\_CONTENT, plan changes \= UPDATE\_PLAN, other settings \= UPDATE\_SETTINGS. |
| BR-17 | Content filter | Tutor posts and tutoring requests containing prohibited words, phone numbers or external links stay in Draft and the owner is notified with the reason; such feedback is not published and the parent is shown the reason to edit it. The filter never sends content to Admin moderation by itself: a post, request, feedback or message goes to moderation only when a user reports it, and a reported post, request or feedback is hidden (Pending moderation) until Admin resolves the report. |
| BR-18 | Classroom  | Each Classroom has only one tutor (tutor create the class) that manage whole assignments, material resource of that class. |

*Table 8\. Business rules*

## **6\. Non-Functional Requirements**

| Category | Requirement |
| ----- | ----- |
| Performance | 95% of API requests respond within 2 seconds under 500 concurrent users; chat messages delivered within 1 second; AI responses start streaming within 5 seconds. |
| Availability | System uptime ≥ 99% per month excluding planned maintenance (announced 24 h ahead). |
| Security | HTTPS/TLS everywhere; passwords hashed with BCrypt; JWT access token 30 min \+ refresh token 7 days; role-based authorization on every API; OAuth tokens and credentials encrypted at rest; payment callbacks verified by checksum; OWASP Top 10 mitigations. |
| Privacy | Personal data processed according to Vietnam Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on personal data protection; tutor documents accessible only to the owner and Admin; contact info protected (BR-15). |
| Usability | Responsive web UI (desktop, tablet, mobile ≥ 360 px); Vietnamese and English UI; main tasks achievable within 3 clicks from the dashboard. |
| Scalability | Stateless API behind a load balancer; background jobs in a queue; files in object storage. |
| Maintainability | Layered/modular architecture per package; code coverage of business services ≥ 60%; API documented with Swagger/OpenAPI. |
| Compatibility | Latest 2 versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari. |
| Reliability | Daily database backup kept 14 days; idempotent payment processing; retry with back-off for external APIs. |

*Table 9\. Non-functional requirements*

| UC ID and Name: | UC01 – Register Account |  |  |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Created By:** | Lại Hữu Quang Anh | **Date Created:** | 29/09/2026 |
| **Primary Actor:** | Guest | **Secondary Actors:** | Email Service |
| **Trigger:** | Guest clicks "Sign up" on the Home page or Login page. |  |  |
| **Description:** | Allows a guest to create a TuConnector account as a Parent, Tutor or Student, using email/password or a Google account. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | PRE-1: The guest is not logged in. PRE-2: The guest has a valid email address. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | POST-1: A new account is created with status "Unverified" and the selected role. POST-2: A verification email is sent; after verification the status becomes "Active". |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **UC01.0 Register Account** 1\. Guest opens the Register screen. 2\. System displays the registration form and role selection (Parent / Tutor / Student). 3\. Guest enters full name, email, password, confirm password and selects a role. 4\. Guest agrees to the Terms of Service and clicks "Register". 5\. System validates the data (BR-01) and checks email uniqueness. 6\. System creates the account, sends a verification link by email and shows a success message. 7\. Guest clicks the link in the email; System activates the account and redirects to Login. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A1: Register with Google** 1\. Guest clicks "Continue with Google". 2\. System redirects to Google OAuth; Guest grants consent. 3\. System receives the Google profile, asks the guest to choose a role and creates an Active account. 4\. System logs the user in and redirects to the role dashboard. **A2: Tutor registration** 1\. If the role is Tutor, after activation System redirects to Manage Profile (UC05) to complete the teaching profile (headline, bio, experience, education, availability); subjects, grade levels and price are published in tutor posts (UC08). |  |  |
| **Exceptions:** | **E1: Invalid or missing data** → System highlights invalid fields with messages (e.g. "Password must be at least 8 characters"). Return to step 3\. **E2: Email already used** → System shows "This email is already registered" and offers "Login" / "Forgot password". **E3: Verification link expired** → System shows "Link expired" and offers "Resend verification email". |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Frequency of Use:** | Once per user. |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-01: Account & password; BR-03: One-time tokens |  |  |
| **Screens:** | SC03 – Register |  |  |

| **Trigger:** | Parent opens a tutoring request and clicks "AI Suggestions", or the system pushes suggestions after a request is created. |  |  |

| **Preconditions:** | PRE-1: The parent is logged in. PRE-2: The parent has at least one Open tutoring request (UC10). |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | POST-1: A ranked list (top 10\) of tutors with a match score and reason is shown and cached for 24 hours. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **UC09.0 View AI Tutor Suggestions** 1\. Parent selects a tutoring request and clicks "AI Suggestions". 2\. System filters tutors by hard constraints (subject, grade, mode, area). 3\. System computes a match score (schedule overlap, budget fit, rating, response rate). 4\. System sends the top candidates and request summary to the AI Provider to generate a short explanation per tutor. 5\. System displays the ranked list with score, reason and an "Invite" button (UC14). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A1: Refine** 1\. Parent adjusts weights (e.g. price vs. rating) and clicks "Refresh"; System recalculates. |  |  |
| **Exceptions:** | **E1: AI Provider unavailable/timeout** → System shows the rule-based ranking without AI explanations and logs the error. **E2: No candidate** → System suggests widening criteria and notifies the parent when a matching tutor registers. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Frequency of Use:** | Per request. |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-13: AI usage |  |  |
| **Screens:** | SC18 – AI Tutor Suggestions |  |  |

| **Primary Actor:** | Parent, Tutor | **Secondary Actors:** | None |
| **Trigger:** | Parent or tutor clicks "Propose agreement" in the 1-1 conversation or in "My Agreements". |  |  |
| **Description:** | Optional tutoring agreement after the parent and the tutor have talked in the app or on Zalo: one side proposes the agreed subject, schedule and price and the other side confirms or rejects it. When confirmed, the request is closed, rating is enabled and the tutor is suggested to create a classroom. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | PRE-1: A 1-1 conversation between the parent and the tutor has been opened (UC13 / UC15). |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | POST-1: The agreement status becomes Confirmed; the request is Closed; other open agreements of the request are Cancelled (proposed by the parent) or Rejected (proposed by a tutor); the parent can rate the tutor (UC36); the tutor sees "Create a classroom" (UC19). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **UC16.0 Confirm Tutoring Agreement** 1\. User clicks "Propose agreement" and enters the agreed subject, schedule and price; the agreement is Pending. 2\. System sends a confirmation request to the other side. 3\. The other side clicks "Confirm". 4\. System sets the agreement to Confirmed, closes the request and notifies both sides. Other open agreements of the same request are closed automatically: those proposed by the parent become Cancelled and those proposed by a tutor become Rejected. 5\. System enables "Rate tutor" for the parent and suggests the tutor to create a classroom. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A1: Reject proposal** 1\. The other side clicks "Reject"; the agreement becomes Rejected and both sides can keep chatting and propose again. **A2: No confirmation** 1\. The two sides keep in touch outside the platform (e.g. Zalo); no agreement is created and nothing else is required. **A3: Cancel proposal** 1\. The proposer cancels a Pending proposal; the agreement becomes Cancelled. |  |  |
| **Exceptions:** | **E1: Request already closed** → System shows "This request is already closed" and does not allow creating a new agreement for it. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | Medium |  |  |
| **Frequency of Use:** | Per conversation. |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | Rating is enabled once per confirmed agreement (UC36) |  |  |
| **Screens:** | SC22 – My Agreements; SC11 – Messages |  |  |

System verifies the IPN signature, upgrades the plan or adds the credits and shows the Payment Result screen. |  |  |

| **Frequency of Use:** | Monthly. |  |  |
| **zBusiness Rules:** | BR-06: Payment orders; Plans per role: Tutor – Free (5 credits/month, basic classroom, email reminders), Pro (30 credits/month, higher AI quota, SMS reminders); Parent – Free / Pro (monthly credits and AI quota configurable in UC39). | **Description:** | Allows a tutor to generate an assignment with AI or create it manually, with three question types (multiple choice, short answer, file upload). The tutor can edit every question, publish with a deadline, grade short-answer and file items, give feedback and publish the results to students and parents. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | PRE-1: The tutor owns the classroom with at least one student. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | POST-1: The assignment is published and students are notified; results are visible to students and linked parents. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **UC24.0 Manage Assignments & Grading** 1\. Tutor clicks "New assignment" and chooses "Generate with AI". 2\. Tutor enters topic, grade, difficulty, number of questions and question types. 3\. System checks the AI quota of the tutor's plan (BR-13) and sends the request to the AI Provider. 4\. System shows the generated questions as an editable draft. 5\. Tutor edits, deletes or adds questions, sets the answer key, points, deadline and late policy. 6\. Tutor clicks "Publish"; System notifies the students. 7\. After submissions (UC25), System auto-grades multiple-choice items. 8\. Tutor grades short-answer and file items and writes feedback. 9\. Tutor clicks "Publish results"; System updates student and parent dashboards and notifies them. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A1: Create manually** 1\. Tutor chooses "Create manually" and adds questions of the three types without AI (steps 2–4 are skipped). **A2: Override auto-grade** 1\. Tutor changes the score of an auto-graded item with a comment. |  |  |
| **Exceptions:** | **E1: AI quota used up / AI timeout** → System informs the tutor, suggests upgrading (UC17) and keeps the manual editor. **E2: Deadline in the past or no answer key for MCQ** → System shows a validation message. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Frequency of Use:** | Weekly. |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-11: Assignments; BR-13: AI usage (quota depends on plan) |  |  |

| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |

| **Primary Actor:** | Tutor | **Secondary Actors:** | Google Calendar API, Email / SMS Service |
| **Trigger:** | Tutor opens the "Schedule" tab of a classroom or the global Calendar. |  |  |
| **Description:** | Allows a tutor to create one-off or recurring sessions (time, duration, online link/location), reschedule, cancel and mark attendance. Changes are pushed to Google Calendar when connected. Reminders are sent by email (Free plan) and by SMS (Pro plan). |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | PRE-1: The tutor owns the classroom. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | POST-1: Sessions are saved; members are notified; Google Calendar events are created/updated; reminders are scheduled (BR-10). |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **UC26.0 Manage Class Schedule** 1\. Tutor clicks "Add session". 2\. Tutor enters date, start time, duration, repeat rule (weekly on selected days until end date), meeting link or address. 3\. System checks conflicts with the tutor's other sessions. 4\. System saves the sessions and notifies class members. 5\. If Google Calendar is connected, System sends calendar requests and stores the returned event IDs. 6\. System schedules reminders 24 hours and 30 minutes before each session: email for all members, SMS when the tutor has the Pro plan. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A1: Reschedule / cancel session** 1\. Tutor changes or cancels a session with a reason (or approves a change request, UC28); System updates Google Calendar and notifies members. **A2: Mark attendance** 1\. After the session, tutor marks Present/Absent/Late for each student; data feeds the dashboards. |  |  |
| **Exceptions:** | **E1: Time conflict** → System shows the conflicting session and blocks saving. **E2: Google Calendar error / token expired** → System saves locally, marks sync Pending and asks the tutor to reconnect (UC29). |  |  |
| **Priority:** | High |  |  |
| **Frequency of Use:** | Weekly. |  |  |
| **Business Rules:** | BR-10: Sessions |  |  |

| **Preconditions:** | PRE-1: The user is a member of the class (a parent through the linked child). PRE-2: The session has not started yet. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | POST-1: A schedule change request with status Pending is created and the tutor is notified. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **UC27.0 Request Schedule Change** 1\. User selects a session and clicks "Request change". 2\. System shows the form: type (move / cancel), proposed date and time, reason. 3\. System saves the request (Pending) and notifies the tutor. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flows:** | **A1: Withdraw request** 1\. User withdraws a Pending request; System notifies the tutor. |  |  |
| **Exceptions:** | **E1: Session starts in less than the minimum notice time** → System shows the rule and asks the user to message the tutor directly. **E2: A Pending request already exists for the session** → System shows the existing request. |  |  |
| **Priority:** | Medium |  |  |
| **Frequency of Use:** | Occasional. |  |  |

# **III. System Design**

## **1\. Package Diagram**

TuConnector follows a layered (clean) architecture. The front-end SPA is split into feature packages matching the functional packages of Section II. The back-end separates API, application (business services), domain, data access and integration layers; background jobs reuse the application services. Dependencies point downward only.

![drawio/package.png][image50]

*Figure 16\. TuConnector package diagram*

| Package | Description / responsibilities |
| ----- | ----- |
| Presentation (Web SPA) | React (JavaScript) single-page application. Feature folders: auth, discovery, hiring, payment, classroom, schedule, chat, ai, dashboard, admin; shared components, API client, WebSocket client. |
| API Layer | Express.js on Node.js: REST routers and controllers per module, Socket.IO for real-time chat and notifications, webhook endpoints (payment IPN), JWT authentication and role-based authorization middleware, request validation, Swagger (OpenAPI). |
| Application / Business Layer | Services per module: AuthService, ProfileService, DiscoveryService, HiringService, MatchingService, PaymentService, ClassroomService, ScheduleService, ChatService, NotificationService, AIAssistantService, DashboardService, AdminService; DTOs and mappers. |
| Domain Layer | Entities, enums, business rules (BR-xx), domain events (AgreementConfirmed, SessionChanged…). |
| Data Access Layer | MongoDB with Mongoose ODM: one model per collection (backend/src/models), embedded sub-schemas and repositories. Collections, validators and indexes are created by init\_tuconnector.js (no migrations). |
| Integration Layer | Adapters: GeminiClient (AI Provider), PaymentGatewayClient (PayOS/VNPay), GoogleCalendarClient, GoogleOAuthClient, EmailSender, FileStorageClient. |
| Background Jobs | Scheduler (node-cron on Node.js): expiry jobs, reminders, calendar sync, email sending, matching recalculation. |
| Cross-cutting | Logging, audit log, configuration, exception handling, security utilities. |

*Table 10\. Package descriptions*

**Mapping of functional packages to code packages:**

| Functional package | Front-end / back-end packages |
| ----- | ----- |
| Authentication & Account | auth / AuthService, ProfileService, GoogleOAuthClient, EmailSender |
| Tutor Discovery | discovery / DiscoveryService, MatchingService, GeminiClient |
| Hiring & Matching | hiring / HiringService, MatchingService |
| Payment | payment / PaymentService, PaymentGatewayClient, Webhooks |
| Classroom Workspace | classroom / ClassroomService, FileStorageClient |
| Schedule & Calendar | schedule / ScheduleService, GoogleCalendarClient, Calendar Sync Worker |
| Communication | chat / ChatService, NotificationService, Hubs |
| AI Assistant | ai-assistant / AIAssistantService, GeminiClient |
| Dashboard & Feedback | dashboard / DashboardService |
| Administration | admin / AdminService, Logging & Audit |

## **2\. Database Design**

### **2.1 Entity-Relationship Diagram**

The ERD shows all 55 tables of the database (keys only: PK, FK, UK); all attributes are listed in 2.2 Table Descriptions. Crow's-foot notation: \|\| \= exactly one, o\| \= zero or one, o\< \= zero or many.

![drawio/erd.png][image51]

*Figure 17\. Entity-Relationship Diagram*

### **2.2 Table Descriptions**

| No | Table | Description | Attributes |
| :---: | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| **1** | ROLES | Lookup of user roles (STUDENT, PARENT, TUTOR, ADMIN). | role\_id (PK), role\_name (UK) |
| **2** | User | Shared user account: login credentials, role and account status. | user\_id (PK), full\_name, email (UK), phone, password\_hash, email\_verify\_status, role\_id (FK), is\_onboarded, created\_at, account\_status, failed\_login\_attempts, last\_login\_at, updated\_at, has\_password, avatar\_url, is\_login\_locked |
| **3** | GOOGLE\_ACCOUNTS | Links a user account to a Google account (OAuth login). | google\_id (PK), user\_id (FK, UK), google\_email |
| **4** | EMAIL\_VERIFICATION\_TOKENS | Tokens/OTPs used to verify an email address. | token\_id (PK), user\_id (FK), token\_value (UK), expired\_at, is\_used |
| **5** | USER\_SESSIONS | Login sessions, storing the refresh token and revocation status. | session\_id (PK), user\_id (FK), refresh\_token (UK), is\_revoked, expires\_at |
| **6** | PASSWORD\_RESET\_TOKENS | Tokens used to reset a password. | token\_id (PK), user\_id (FK), token\_value (UK), expired\_at, is\_used |
| **7** | USER\_CALENDAR\_TOKENS | Tokens connecting a user's personal calendar (Google Calendar). | token\_id (PK), user\_id (FK, UK), provider, access\_token, refresh\_token, google\_calendar\_id, is\_connected, last\_synced\_at, expires\_at |
| **8** | TUTOR\_PROFILES | Tutor profile: introduction, address, availability and average rating. | profile\_id (PK), user\_id (FK, UK), headline, bio, avatar\_url, cover\_url, address, is\_address\_hidden, is\_complete, availability\_status, average\_rating |
| **9** | EXPERIENCES | Work experience of a tutor. | exp\_id (PK), profile\_id (FK), title, company, start\_date, end\_date |
| **10** | ACHIEVEMENTS | Achievements and awards of a tutor. | ach\_id (PK), profile\_id (FK), title, description |
| **11** | EDUCATIONS | Education and degrees of a tutor. | edu\_id (PK), profile\_id (FK), school, degree, graduation\_year, description |
| **12** | USER\_CREDITS | Current credit balance of a user (tutor or parent). | credit\_id (PK), user\_id (FK, UK), balance, updated\_at |
| **13** | CREDIT\_TRANSACTIONS | History of a user's credit changes (monthly grant, purchase, used for an application or invitation, expired monthly credits). | transaction\_id (PK), user\_id (FK), amount, type, related\_apply\_id (FK), related\_invitation\_id (FK), expires\_at, created\_at |
| **14** | REVIEWS | Parent reviews of a tutor, with sub-ratings, the tutor's reply and moderation status. | review\_id (PK), tutor\_profile\_id (FK), rating, comment, created\_at, agreement\_id (FK, UK), parent\_user\_id (FK), knowledge\_rating, punctuality\_rating, communication\_rating, tutor\_reply, replied\_at, status, updated\_at |
| **15** | TUTOR\_POSTS | Posts in which a tutor offers teaching services. | post\_id (PK), profile\_id (FK), title, subject\_name, grade\_level, teaching\_mode, price, schedule, description, image\_urls, status, created\_at, updated\_at |
| **16** | PARENT\_REQUESTS | Requests posted by parents to find a tutor (subject, budget, schedule, tutor requirements). | request\_id (PK), parent\_user\_id (FK), title, subject\_name, grade\_level, teaching\_mode, budget, schedule, description, location\_address, image\_urls, status, created\_at, updated\_at, student\_id (FK), tutor\_requirements |
| **17** | APPLY\_REQUESTS | Applications of tutors to a parent's request, with a short note and a match score. | apply\_id (PK), request\_id (FK), tutor\_profile\_id (FK), note, match\_score, status, created\_at, updated\_at |
| **18** | BOOKMARKED\_REQUESTS | Parent requests saved by tutors. | bookmark\_id (PK), tutor\_profile\_id (FK), request\_id (FK), created\_at |
| **19** | TUTOR\_INVITATIONS | Invitations sent by a parent to a tutor for a request. | invitation\_id (PK), parent\_user\_id (FK), tutor\_profile\_id (FK), request\_id (FK), message, status, created\_at, updated\_at |
| **20** | TUTORING\_AGREEMENTS | Tutoring agreement proposed by one side of a conversation and confirmed by the other (agreed subject, schedule and tuition). | agreement\_id (PK), conversation\_id (FK), proposer\_user\_id (FK), accepted\_by\_user\_id (FK), agreed\_subject, agreed\_schedule, agreed\_price, status, created\_at, updated\_at |
| **21** | CLASSROOMS | Online classes created by tutors, with a join code and invite link. | class\_id (PK), tutor\_profile\_id (FK), agreement\_id (FK), name, subject, grade, description, capacity, join\_code (UK), invite\_link (UK), status, created\_at, updated\_at |
| **22** | CLASS\_MEMBERS | Members of a class (students, parents) and their membership status. | member\_id (PK), class\_id (FK), user\_id (FK), joined\_at, status, removal\_reason |
| **23** | CLASS\_ANNOUNCEMENTS | Class announcements posted by the tutor, which can be pinned. | announcement\_id (PK), class\_id (FK), author\_profile\_id (FK), content, is\_pinned, created\_at, updated\_at |
| **24** | MATERIAL\_TOPICS | Topics used to group materials within a class. | topic\_id (PK), class\_id (FK), name, created\_at |
| **25** | CLASS\_MATERIALS | Learning materials of a class (documents, videos, links, assignments). | material\_id (PK), class\_id (FK), topic\_id (FK), uploader\_profile\_id (FK), title, material\_type, file\_url, file\_size, visibility, created\_at, updated\_at |
| **26** | ASSIGNMENTS | Class assignments: due date, maximum points, late/resubmission rules, AI-generated flag. | assignment\_id (PK), class\_id (FK), creator\_profile\_id (FK), title, instructions, is\_ai\_generated, status, due\_date, allow\_late\_submission, allow\_resubmission, total\_points, published\_at, results\_published\_at, created\_at, updated\_at |
| **27** | ASSIGNMENT\_QUESTIONS | Questions of an assignment (multiple choice, short answer, file upload). | question\_id (PK), assignment\_id (FK), question\_number, question\_type, content, options, correct\_answer, points |
| **28** | ASSIGNMENT\_SUBMISSIONS | A student's submission for an assignment, with scores and feedback. | submission\_id (PK), assignment\_id (FK), student\_user\_id (FK), attempt\_number, status, timeliness, provisional\_score, final\_score, overall\_feedback, submitted\_at, graded\_at |
| **29** | SUBMISSION\_ANSWERS | A student's detailed answer to each question, with score and comment. | answer\_id (PK), submission\_id (FK), question\_id (FK), text\_response, file\_url, file\_size, score, is\_auto\_graded, is\_overridden, comment |
| **30** | ASSIGNMENT\_ATTACHMENTS | Links assignments to attached materials. | attachment\_id (PK), assignment\_id (FK), material\_id (FK) |
| **31** | RECURRING\_RULES | Rules for recurring class schedules (days of week, start time, duration, end date). | rule\_id (PK), class\_id (FK), days\_of\_week, start\_time, duration\_minutes, end\_date |
| **32** | CLASS\_SESSIONS | Individual class sessions: time, meeting link and status. | session\_id (PK), class\_id (FK), tutor\_profile\_id (FK), rule\_id (FK), title, start\_time, end\_time, meeting\_link, status, created\_at, updated\_at |
| **33** | SESSION\_ATTENDANCE | Student attendance for each session. | attendance\_id (PK), session\_id (FK), student\_user\_id (FK), status, comment, marked\_at |
| **34** | SCHEDULE\_CHANGE\_REQUESTS | Requests to reschedule or cancel a session, and the responses. | request\_id (PK), session\_id (FK), requester\_user\_id (FK), responder\_user\_id (FK), request\_type, proposed\_start\_time, proposed\_end\_time, reason, status, response\_comment, responded\_at, created\_at |
| **35** | SESSION\_REMINDERS | Session reminders sent by email or SMS. | reminder\_id (PK), session\_id (FK), user\_id (FK), channel, trigger\_time, scheduled\_for, status, sent\_at |
| **36** | SESSION\_CALENDAR\_SYNC | Sync status of a session to a user's Google Calendar. | sync\_id (PK), session\_id (FK), user\_id (FK), google\_event\_id, sync\_status, last\_error, synced\_at |
| **37** | MESSAGES | Messages within a conversation. | message\_id (PK), conversation\_id (FK), sender\_user\_id (FK), message\_type, content, created\_at |
| **38** | MESSAGE\_ATTACHMENTS | Files attached to messages. | attachment\_id (PK), message\_id (FK), file\_url, file\_name, file\_size, mime\_type |
| **39** | CONVERSATION\_READ\_STATES | Per-user read state of messages in a conversation. | state\_id (PK), conversation\_id (FK), user\_id (FK), last\_read\_message\_id (FK), read\_at |
| **40** | CONTENT\_REPORTS | General content violation reports (posts, requests, reviews, messages, users, classes) and the admin's resolution. | report\_id (PK), reporter\_user\_id (FK), target\_type, target\_id, reason, severity, status, action\_taken, admin\_note, resolved\_by\_admin\_id (FK), resolved\_at, created\_at |
| **41** | NOTIFICATIONS | System notifications sent to users. | notification\_id (PK), recipient\_user\_id (FK), category, title, body, target\_type, target\_id, is\_read, read\_at, created\_at |
| **42** | NOTIFICATION\_DELIVERY\_LOGS | Delivery log of notifications by channel and delivery status. | log\_id (PK), notification\_id (FK), recipient\_user\_id (FK), channel, status, error\_message, dispatched\_at |
| **43** | NOTIFICATION\_PREFERENCES | A user's notification settings (channels and notification types). | preference\_id (PK), user\_id (FK, UK), enable\_in\_app, enable\_email, enable\_sms, notify\_on\_sessions, notify\_on\_assignments, notify\_on\_messages, updated\_at |
| **44** | PARENT\_CHILD\_LINKS | Links between parents and students. | link\_id (PK), parent\_user\_id (FK), student\_user\_id (FK), status, created\_at, updated\_at |
| **45** | ADMIN\_AUDIT\_LOGS | Audit log of administrator actions. | log\_id (PK), admin\_user\_id (FK), target\_user\_id (FK), action, reason, details\_json, ip\_address, created\_at |
| **46** | PLANS | Subscription plans per role (tutor / parent): price, monthly credits, AI quota, SMS reminders, maximum classes. | plan\_id (PK), target\_role, name, monthly\_price, monthly\_credits, ai\_quota, sms\_reminders\_enabled, is\_active, max\_classrooms |
| **47** | CREDIT\_PACKS | Credit top-up packs, for one role or for both. | pack\_id (PK), target\_role, name, credit\_amount, price, is\_active |
| **48** | SUBSCRIPTIONS | A user's current subscription (tutor or parent) and the AI quota used. | subscription\_id (PK), user\_id (FK), plan\_id (FK), status, expires\_at, ai\_quota\_used, ai\_quota\_reset\_at, start\_date, created\_at |
| **49** | PAYMENT\_ORDERS | A user's payment orders (plan with a duration or credit pack with a quantity), with payment method and status. | order\_id (PK), order\_code (UK), user\_id (FK), item\_type, plan\_id (FK), pack\_id (FK), quantity, duration\_months, amount, payment\_method, status, ipn\_signature, paid\_at, created\_at |
| **50** | RECEIPTS | Receipts/e-invoices for orders. | receipt\_id (PK), order\_id (FK, UK), receipt\_url, created\_at |
| **51** | STUDENTS | Student profile, 1-1 with a student user account. | user\_id (PK), full\_name, grade\_level |
| **52** | AI\_SUGGESTIONS | AI suggestions matching tutors/posts to a parent's request. | suggestion\_id (PK), request\_id (FK), tutor\_post\_id (FK), tutor\_profile\_id (FK), match\_score, ai\_reason, weights\_json, cached\_until, created\_at |
| **53** | AI\_POST\_SUGGESTIONS | AI suggestions recommending suitable requests to a tutor. | suggestion\_id (PK), tutor\_profile\_id (FK), request\_id (FK), match\_score, ai\_reason, cached\_until, created\_at |
| **54** | CONVERSATIONS | Conversations between a parent and a tutor (direct, request-based or class chat). | conversation\_id (PK), parent\_user\_id (FK), tutor\_profile\_id (FK), is\_active, created\_at, request\_id (FK), class\_id (FK, UK), type, updated\_at |
| **55** | SAVED\_SEARCHES | Search filters saved by a parent. | search\_id (PK), user\_id (FK), search\_name, filter\_criteria\_json, created\_at |
